findings.location: Article HTML, opening Scripture quotation (1 Wakorintho 13:1-13)
findings.source_quote: “Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the corrupted characters “yatाबatilika” with Kiswahili text, for example “yatabatilika,” so the sentence reads “zikiwepo lugha, zitakoma; yakiwepo maarifa, yatabatilika.”

findings.location: Article HTML, section 3. Generosity, paragraph beginning “There is only one character trait…”
findings.source_quote: “If envy rules, subtle things like carrying a cabinet awkwardly can hinder the work. Pinching someone’s fingers in a tight doorway is a perfect way to reduce my foe down to his size and the work successfully is hindered, and I can still maintain my innocence.”
findings.suggested_fix: Revise this sentence to preserve the speaker’s description of spitefully pinching someone’s fingers in a tight doorway and hindering the work while maintaining plausible innocence; for example: “Kumnasa mtu vidole kwenye mlango mwembamba ni njia nzuri ya kumshusha adui yangu hadi kiwango chake na kuzuia kazi ifanyike vizuri, nami bado ninaweza kujifanya sina hatia.”
findings.translation_quote: “Kumnasa mtu vidole kwenye mlango mwembamba ni njia bora ya kumshusha adui yangu hadi kiwango chake na kuzuia kazi ifanyike vizuri, nami bado ninaweza kuendelea kujiona sina hatia.”

findings.source_quote: “If we treat our spouses dishonorably and with disrespect, there is a good chance they will become or remain the person we detest.”
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the garbled phrase “Tukiwa tenda wake zetu” to express treating one’s spouse dishonorably and disrespectfully, for example: “Tukiwatendea wenzi wetu kwa dharau na bila heshima, kuna uwezekano mkubwa kwamba watakuwa au wataendelea kuwa watu tunaowachukia.”
findings.translation_quote: “Tukiwa tenda wake zetu kwa dharau na bila heshima, kuna uwezekano mkubwa kwamba watakuwa au wataendelea kuwa watu tunaowachukia.”
